jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Project Overview:**

NOAA Fisheries are undertaking modernization across its application environment. The NMFS Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) supports headquarters, national programs, regional offices, and science centers across an operationally decentralized agency. The primary objective of this position is to serve as a **Technical Project Manager** across two work streams: A) support the OCIO to establish an engineering foundation that transitions software development from isolated efforts into a modular, shared platform model, eliminate deployment friction and accelerate the delivery of secure, compliant software into production. B) Lead the organization, customer engagement and priorities software, data and system governance framework for the East Coast Logbook Project. The position will work to ensure that data and system governance protocols and procedures are fully documented and applied to support enterprise data management solutions.

**Scope of Work & Responsibilities**

* **Project Management**
  + Serves as a project manager, managing the full system development life cycle , assigning and monitoring project work among development team members, setting goals and priorities, and approving work schedules and deliverables for the completion of trade monitoring application development projects.
  + PM will work closely with the government PM for tasking and roadmap planning.
  + Operates under an iterative, performance-based agile delivery framework across all workstreams. Rather than tracking fixed calendar deadlines or static milestone documentation, delivery is managed dynamically through a prioritized product backlog in two-week sprint cycles.
* **Governance and Documentation:**
  + Collaborate with the East Coast Logbook Project's core team and stakeholders from GARFO, SERO, SEFSC, and Atlantic HMS to document the formal data governance group, including its purpose, roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes.
  + Engage with developers, legal counsel (Office of General Counsel), and other stakeholders to document policies and procedures; including but not limited to, the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) in relation to the East Coast Logbook Project.
  + Develop and draft a Terms of Reference document for the governance group, outlining its purpose, roles, responsibilities, and decision-making processes.
  + Document a regular meeting cadence for the governance group to ensure continuous oversight and collaborative decision-making.
* **Policy and Procedure Documentation:**
  + Collaborate with project stakeholders, including technical staff and subject matter experts, to identify, document, and maintain data governance protocols, procedures, and standards for the new, shared data system.
  + Ensure that all governance documentation aligns with Federal, Commerce, and NOAA data policies and strategies.
* **Corporate and Implementation Support and Communication:**
  + Advise and support the project team in the implementation and adoption of the defined data governance protocols.
  + Provide guidance on best practices for technical documentation and knowledge transfer.
  + Prepare and present reports to the Project's Executive Sponsors and core team on the progress of governance formalization and implementation.
  + Facilitate communication among the different regional offices to ensure a unified approach to data governance.
  + Contribute to T&T proposal activities and all other duties as assigned by T&T managers.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as English, Communications, Computer Science, or Information Management, and equivalent practical experience in technical writing, data governance, or a related discipline.
* 5+ more years of experience as a project manager, ideally with experience in data governance, information management, and software development.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing documentation for data governance frameworks, policies, and procedures.
* Experience working with federal data policies, such as those from the Department of Commerce, NOAA, and specifically the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA), is highly desirable.
* The position requires extensive knowledge of and experience managing the full system development life cycle for web-based, database-driven, custom software development projects, including gathering requirements, designing, developing, and implementing information management systems and the ability to design, develop, and administrate databases and applications, applying a high degree of imagination and creativity to problems recognized as critical obstacles to progress in an area of exceptional interest
* The position requires extensive knowledge of and experience working on web-based, database-driven, custom software development projects utilizing Java, and Oracle technologies.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, with experience preparing and presenting to a variety of audiences, including senior leadership, legal staff, and technical teams.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Must be a US Citizen or Permanent Resident and be able to obtain a security badge to enter a government facility.

**Desirable Skills:**

* Project management experience
* Governance understanding and approaches
* Git (Hub and Lab) experience
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Knowledge of Federal fisheries management

**Travel** The contractor is expected to travel as required for meetings both local and potentially longer distances, with all travel expenses reimbursable in accordance with Federal Travel Regulations.

**Benefits:** Competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, life insurance coverage, 401(k) plan, training programs, accrued paid time off (PTO), performance based monthly & quarterly awards, paid holidays and customer kudo rewards.

***Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disable

Description:

**About us:**

Momentus provides industry-leading event and venue management software to customers in over 50 countries around the world, serving thousands of customers that power millions of events. In the age of digital transformation, our comprehensive platform offers event professionals leading-edge SaaS technology that provides a 360 view of their business, allowing them to cut costs, save time, and increase revenue. Momentus technology powers top shows around the world, famous museums, global convention centers, performing arts venues, professional sports arenas, and other unique venues. Our client list includes The Apollo Theatre, Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Harvard University, Portland'5 Centers for the Arts, the Javitz Center, and St. Louis Art Museum. Some of our global clients include: ExCel London, Museum of Contemporary Art Australia, Omanexpo, the China National Convention Center, the Porsche Experience Center in Germany and the Sydney Opera House.

The Professional Services, Program Manager, Strategic Enterprise Implementation owns the day-to-day operating cadence for a single, large-scale, multi-site enterprise implementation program. They will be the point person on a program that spans dozens of locations, multiple rollout phases, and a multi-year timeline. This role keeps a high-stakes program moving by driving stakeholder engagement, tracking dates and milestones, running meetings, maintaining the risk and action-item log, and routing blockers to the right internal team. Success means the program never loses momentum, and every team stays pointed at the same goals, and nothing falls through the cracks at scale.

**Program Cadence & Coordination**

* Own the recurring meeting cadence for the program (core team check-ins, working group sessions, leadership reviews) — scheduling, agendas, and follow-through.
* Take and distribute notes from program meetings, ensuring decisions and commitments are captured and visible to all stakeholders.
* Maintain the master roadmap and milestone tracker, keeping phase dates, go-live targets, and dependencies current and visible.
* Keep the program's shared documentation (trackers, plans, contracts-in-progress, status pages) accurate and up to date.

**Team Alignment & Momentum**

* Keep every workstream and team both internal and customer-side, oriented around the program's shared outcomes and goals, not just their own slice of the work.
* Proactively check progress against plan at the scale this program demands (hundreds of concurrent or sequenced venues), catching slowdowns before they compound across waves.
* Re-align teams quickly when priorities shift, a date slips, or a workstream drift from the agreed plan — don't wait for the next scheduled check-in to course-correct.
* Keep cross-functional partners (Sales, Legal, Product, Engineering, Customer Success) and the customer's team rowing in the same direction, even as the program moves through different phases and waves.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as the connective tissue between the customer's stakeholders and internal teams (Sales, Legal, Product, Engineering, Customer Success).
* Build and sustain engagement with customer-side points of contact across a large, often multi-entity organization.
* Prepare and deliver regular status updates and executive summaries tailored to customer and internal leadership audiences.

**Risk & Action Item Tracking**

* Maintain a living risk and blocker log; proactively flag items that threaten timeline, scope, or sentiment.
* Track open action items to closure, chasing owners and escalating when dates slip.
* Distinguish between items the program can resolve directly and items that need escalation (technical, commercial, or legal) — and make sure escalations land with the right owner.

**Cross-Functional Escalation & Routing**

* Route technical blockers (e.g., integrations, data migration, identity/access, payment processing) to Product and Engineering with enough context for them to act.
* Coordinate with Sales and Legal on contract and scoping timelines that gate program sequencing.
* Flag when a program risk needs leadership visibility or a decision above the program manager's authority.

**Executive Reporting & Visibility**

* Own the recurring executive reporting rhythm for the program; both internal (to company leadership) and customer-facing (to the customer's executive sponsors).
* Build and deliver internal executive updates that give leadership a clear, honest read on scope, timeline, risk, and sentiment, so decisions and support can happen before issues become urgent.
* Build and deliver customer-facing executive summaries that keep the customer's sponsors confident in the program's progress, written to maintain trust even when flagging risk.
* Tailor message and level of detail to each audience: leadership needs the headline and the ask; the customer executives need the narrative and the reassurance, while keeping the underlying facts consistent across both.
* Keep a single source of truth for program status that both the customer and internal leadership can reference formal updates.

Requirements:  

* 4+ years in program or project coordination, implementation management, or customer-facing delivery roles in an enterprise B2B SaaS environment.
* Experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-phase programs at scale (hundreds of sites/locations), comfortable managing many moving parts without owning the underlying technical work.
* A track record of keeping large, cross-functional efforts aligned and moving with the ability to spot drift early and re-rally teams around the program's goals rather than letting momentum stall.
* Strong organizational skills: scheduling, documentation, and follow-through are core to this role, not an afterthought.

**About Us:**  
At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.  
  
**Position Overview:**

  

The GTM Enablement Program Manager owns readiness and performance for Fullbay's go-to-market teams — Marketing, BDR, and Sales. This role carries launch and change readiness for the GTM motion end to end, builds and maintains the talk tracks and plays those teams sell with, delivers sales skills programs to anyone at Fullbay who sells, and owns the content management system and governance that keep every enablement asset current, findable, and on-message. It also owns the Revenue Team onboarding foundation — the shared first weeks every customer-facing hire completes — in partnership with People Experience, while role-specific ramp stays with each audience owner. It is a blend of program management discipline and hands-on enablement craft: one week aligning Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps on what a launch asks reps to do differently, the next scoring call recordings to see whether they did it.

  

**The Right Wrench for the Job**

In a heavy-duty shop, the tech who earns trust isn't the one waiting for instructions on every bolt — it's the one who knows the job, makes smart calls at the bay, and speaks up when there's a better way to get the truck back on the road. That's the mindset this role is built for.

You'll own the GTM enablement portfolio end to end. Strategy and priority are set in partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement — how those outcomes get achieved is yours to run. You hold the manager-tier relationships in Sales, BDR, and Marketing directly, source your own scope from those stakeholders, and define success measures for every program you design. You're the right fit if you're an organized, self-directed professional who can hold a dozen moving parts without dropping one, who is as comfortable building a talk track as building a content taxonomy, and who brings ideas to the table rather than waiting to be handed them. We're looking for someone who proposes, decides, and executes with autonomy. If you want to build enablement that visibly changes how Fullbay's revenue teams sell, we'd like to talk.

* Translates ambiguous asks into clearly scoped programs with defined audiences, outcomes, and success measures
* Partners with Product Marketing so that positioning, customer education, and rep enablement tell one story — built once, framed for each audience
  

**Launch & Change Readiness**

* Owns launch and change readiness for the go-to-market motion — translating product releases, pricing and packaging changes, and process changes into what Marketing, BDR, and Sales need to know, say, and do differently
* Builds the readiness plan for each launch, sequences enablement against the launch calendar, and confirms readiness before go-live
* Sequences and prioritizes work across a portfolio of concurrent launches and programs, flagging collisions and dependencies early
  

**Sales Skills, Talk Tracks & Plays**

* Builds and maintains talk tracks, plays, discovery guides, objection handling, and demo narratives grounded in Fullbay's sales methodology and GTM motion
* Designs and delivers sales skills programs to anyone at Fullbay who sells, including Customer Success on expansion motions, with reinforcement materials and coaching guides that put the skill in managers' hands
* Reviews call recordings against talk-track and methodology standards, and turns what the data shows into coaching content and program adjustments
  

**Content Management & Governance**

* Owns the enablement content management system — intake, taxonomy, versioning, freshness, and retirement — across every enablement asset the function produces
* Sets and enforces content governance standards so materials stay current, accurate, and easy to find for every customer-facing team
* Runs the intake path for enablement requests and reports turnaround, asset freshness, and retirement rate
  

**Revenue Team Onboarding**

jobs.title: Senior Technology Project Manager – Banking Systems
jobs.description:
Luminate Bank is redefining what modern banking can be. In just five years under its current leadership, the company has grown from a $62 million community bank into a $500 million financial institution, the fastest-growing state-chartered bank, while building one of the fastest-growing mortgage platforms in the country.

The momentum has been extraordinary:

* Grew bank assets from $62 million to $500 million in five years- the fastest-growing state-chartered bank
* Ranked a 2026 Top Workplace in Minnesota by the Star Tribune and #1 among large companies in Colorado Top Workplaces 2026
* Named a 2026 Top Workplaces Culture Excellence winner in eight categories and a Top Workplace nationally in Financial Services
* Surpassed $4 billion in mortgage originations in 2025
* Ranked among the Top 30 Mortgage Lenders nationally by Scotsman Guide
* Maintain a 4.9-star average rating across 45,000+ customer reviews
* Recognized by Freddie Mac with two 2026 Home Possible RISE Awards® for Greatest Volume and Fastest Growth
* Honored by the Minnesota Mortgage Association as 2025 Leaders of the Year

  

But the story is bigger than growth metrics and awards. Luminate Bank is building a culture designed for ambitious, high-performing people who want to shape the future of banking. We move quickly, think boldly, and invest deeply in our people. Innovation, accountability, collaboration, and customer experience are at the center of everything we do.

What began as a rapidly growing lending and banking platform is now entering its next phase: building a nationally recognized financial brand that redefines how modern banking is experienced.

For leaders who want the opportunity to build, scale, and leave a lasting impact, this is a rare moment to join a company with startup energy, national momentum, and a long runway ahead.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Luminate Bank is building a technology team that moves fast and delivers. We are looking for a Senior Technology Project Manager who owns our bank technology projects from idea to go-live. You will set the plan, assign the work, lead our core and digital banking vendors, and make sure projects finish on time and in scope.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will translate business needs into clear requirements for Jack Henry and our other core banking system providers, recommend the right technical solution, and partner with our development team when a gap calls for a proprietary application or AI agent built on vendor APIs.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**

**Own and Run Projects**

* Lead bank technology projects end to end: intake, scoping, planning, execution, testing, go-live and post-launch review.
* Build and maintain project plans with tasks, owners, dates and dependencies; assign work across business, technology and vendor teams.
* Run kickoffs, working sessions and status meetings; publish clear weekly status, risks and decisions.
* Hold stakeholders and vendors to their commitments; escalate early, with a recommended path forward, when dates or quality are at risk.
* Manage several projects at once and keep them moving; no project stalls without a plan to unblock it.

**Control Scope and Deliver Quickly**

* Define scope, success criteria and out-of-scope items up front and get business sign-off before work begins.
* Run a formal change-request process; assess the impact of new asks on time, cost and risk before accepting them.
* Break large initiatives into phased deliveries that put value in users’ hands sooner.

**Lead Vendor Implementations**

* Manage implementations, upgrades and conversions with Jack Henry and other core, digital banking, payments and fintech providers.
* Review SOWs and project plans with Vendor Management; own the bank-side plan and hold vendors to theirs.
* Coordinate testing (UAT), cutover planning, training and go-live readiness.

**Business Analysis & Technical Recommendations**

* Lead discovery with business owners; document current- and future-state processes and requirements.
* Write clear functional and technical requirements for vendors, and translate vendor responses back for the business.
* Evaluate options (configure, buy, or build) and recommend solutions with trade-offs, cost and risk.
* Work with the Engineering team on integrations, proprietary applications and AI agents that use vendor APIs; define requirements, acceptance criteria and priorities, while Engineering builds.

**Bring Order and Improve How We Work**

* Organize business stakeholders: clarify roles, decision owners and deadlines for every project.
* Follow and help improve our SDLC, documentation standards, change management, release planning, intake and capacity planning.
* Keep project documentation, requirements and decisions current and audit-ready.
* Identify and champion AI-enabled tools that speed up requirements, ticket writing and project management.
* Provide hands-on coordination during high-priority incidents or critical release events affecting bank systems.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years of project management in banking or financial services technology, including leading third-party vendor implementations to go-live.
* Hands-on experience with core banking systems; Jack Henry (SilverLake) and MANTL strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of bank operations and products: deposits, lending, payments, digital banking, and related compliance (e.g., BSA/AML, Reg E, vendor risk).
* Proven record of setting scope, preventing scope creep and delivering on schedule.
* Strong business analysis skills: discovery, process mapping, requirements and UAT.
* Enough technical fluency to discuss APIs, integrations, data flows and system configuration with vendors and engineers.
* Confident, proactive leader who assigns work, follows up and holds peers, business leaders and vendors accountable.
* Clear written and verbal communication with executives, business users and technical teams.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace! We are a vibrant, mission-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world. Whether contributing to world-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you!

 **Job Description**

**This position is a remote (U.S.-based), limited-term, grant-funded position expected to run through August 31, 2029, with frequent travel across East Africa.**

Are you a dynamic international development leader passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technology and climate innovation to transform agricultural livelihoods across Africa?

As the **Program Manager for East Africa**, you will serve as the operational anchor and strategic focal point for our flagship **AI Weather and Advisory Services portfolio**. Operating at the intersection of climate resilience, artificial intelligence, and scalable agricultural transformation, you will translate high-level global investments into high-impact, on-the-ground technical assistance across East Africa.

Reporting directly to the Secretariat Director, you will lead day-to-day coordination across country-based teams, collaborate with national ministries and meteorological agencies, and interface directly with Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs). You will drive work planning, milestone execution, budget management, and partner alignment to deliver actionable, AI-driven weather and agricultural advisories to millions of smallholder farmers.

**About AIM for Scale:**

The **Agricultural Innovation Mechanism for Scale (AIM for Scale)** is a global initiative dedicated to identifying, adapting, and scaling evidence-based, cost-effective agricultural innovations to improve smallholder farmer livelihoods and food security in low- and middle-income countries.

Co-hosted by the **University of Notre Dame’s Keough School of Global Affairs** and **New York University Abu Dhabi**, AIM for Scale is supported by world-renowned funding partners, including the **Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation** and the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**. The AIM for Scale Secretariat is proudly based at the Keough School of Global Affairs.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Bonneville Labs is a flexible coworking and traditional lab space operator and developer optimized for a community of Bio-Doers, emerging biotechnology companies, community partners, and life sciences market leaders. Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. Bonneville Labs seeks to improve our world and lives by eliminating operational hurdles and reducing the cost of research and development for our member companies and allowing them to go forward, faster toward world changing discoveries and businesses.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**
============================================

Reports To: CEO

**Job Overview**
----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. This role builds structured systems, harmonizes workflows, and ensures programs move from planning to completion with clarity, accountability, and measurable outcomes. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.
* Balance strategic planning with hands‑on execution to keep programs moving without gaps or delays.
* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.
* Conduct post‑implementation reviews and initiate timely improvements when needed.
* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

The Senior Strategic and Operational Intelligence Analyst delivers proactive, forward-looking analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translates that analysis into direction and action for Humana's information security organization. You will set the strategic threat picture that guides CTI collection, processing, and analysis while supporting the development of proactive countermeasures that reduce Humana's exposure before threats materialize. Working with operational analysts, the analyst ensures strategic analysis translates into operational outcomes by shaping what CTI tracks, what partners act on, and where Humana strengthens its preparedness. The analyst applies AI, automation, and disciplined analysis to identify what matters most, anticipate changes in the threat landscape, and lead action on priority cyber threats. The analyst is comfortable working directly with threat and security data, exploring patterns, testing hypotheses, and combining quantitative evidence with qualitative intelligence to produce defensible assessments and practical recommendations.

**Main Responsibilities**

**Threat Prioritization**

* Own the actor and threat prioritization framework that guides CTI's operational focus, collection posture, and countermeasure development
* Identify priority threats and actors relevant to Enterprise Information Protection, Technology, Business, and Enterprise partners; ensure prioritization reflects sector-specific and Humana-specific risk
* Continuously update the prioritization frameworks as the threat landscape shifts, using AI and automation to help build and maintain them at scale, and ensure they are embedded in how the CTI team and its stakeholders make decisions

**Threat Analysis and Reporting**

* Produce recurring and ad-hoc assessments of the current and projected threat landscape, framed for Humana-specific relevance and decision-making
* Analyze internal and external threat, vulnerability, and security data to identify patterns, assess relevance to Humana, and distinguish meaningful changes from noise
* Clearly articulate priority current and emerging threats and their implications in both written products and verbal briefings to internal and external stakeholders, including leadership stakeholders
* Spearhead strategic threat perspectives in support of CTI's engagement with Humana’s strategic initiatives, ensuring policies and planning are proactively informed by the threat landscape
* Generate industry-leading analysis from concept to delivery with limited direction, sometimes on tight deadlines

**Countermeasures Development**

* Contribute to the development of proactive countermeasure packages that translate threat analysis into specific, prioritized actions for Detection Engineering, SOC, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and other consuming teams
* Work closely with CTI peers and control owners to ensure recommendations are actionable, appropriately scoped, feasible, and tied to current threats

**Program Maturation and Tradecraft**

* Influence the maturation and efficacy of the CTI program through continual improvement of analytic practices, tools, and services
* Review and edit CTI finished intelligence prior to dissemination, ensuring adherence to industry-leading analytic tradecraft standards and reinforcing rigorous analytic thinking across the team
* Apply AI and automation tools to enhance analysis, improve speed to insight, and deliver higher-impact intelligence outcomes; contribute to how the CTI team adopts and integrates AI into analytic workflows
* Experiment with data sources, analytic methods, and tools to answer emerging intelligence questions; refine approaches based on what the evidence shows

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of intelligence experience, with meaningful time in all-source cyber threat analysis and demonstrated experience contributing to operational intelligence workflows
* Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on problem-solving: comfortable exploring unfamiliar data, testing approaches, and adjusting an analysis
* Experience with the cyber threat landscape, including prominent actors, TTPs, and sector-specific threat trends
* Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and their application to intelligence analysis, including using AI to accelerate research, structure analysis, and maintain analytic products at scale
* Experience analyzing structured or semi-structured data to answer intelligence questions, identify trends or anomalies, and communicate the limitations of the data and the confidence of resulting judgments

* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate complex subjects concisely
* Experience conducting analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translating that analysis into direction and action
* Working knowledge of security controls, enterprise technologies, telemetry, and defensive workflows, with experience partnering with detection, hunting, response, or vulnerability

* Demonstrated ability to influence program strategy and improve of practices, tools, and services

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience integrating AI or automation into intelligence workflows, including collection, analysis, or reporting
* Experience with ISAC engagement and information sharing across peer organizations
* Relevant security certification

As a Research Analyst, you will turn all-source C-UxS information into analytical products that directly shape DHS and DoD technology acquisition and the development of tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). You’ll work with Amentum, government, vendors, subject matter experts, and other industry partners. Your findings will reach senior decision makers.

**What You’ll Do**

**Analysis and Threat Assessment**

* Analyze structured and unstructured UxS movement data, geospatial sensor information, and supplementary intelligence sources to develop actionable analytical products.
* Brief key decision-makers on UxS movement trends, entities, areas of interest, and evolving threat patterns through reports, presentations, and research projects.
* Conduct predictive and anticipatory analysis to identify emerging UxS threats, forecast potential operational activities, and assess likely changes in adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures.
* Identify patterns, anomalies, and indicators of potential future UxS activity by integrating historical movement data, geospatial information, environmental conditions, and other relevant intelligence sources.
* Develop threat forecasts and risk assessments that identify potential vulnerabilities, emerging operational challenges, and areas requiring enhanced surveillance, detection, or mitigation capabilities.
* Apply trend analysis, pattern-of-life assessments, and temporal and geospatial modeling to anticipate changes in UxS employment, operating environments, and threat behavior.

**Predictive Analytics and Operational Decision Support**

* Develop and apply predictive analytical models, statistical forecasting techniques, and AI-enabled analytical tools to assess potential UxS activities, operational trends, and emerging threats.
* Conduct anticipatory assessments that evaluate plausible future threat scenarios, identify early warning indicators, and provide decision-makers with actionable recommendations.
* Establish and monitor indicators and warnings (I&W) to support early identification of emerging UxS threats, evolving capabilities, and changes in operational activity.
* Perform scenario-based analysis and forecasting to evaluate potential threat developments, operational vulnerabilities, and C-UxS capability requirements.
* Translate predictive assessments into operational recommendations that support proactive resource allocation, sensor placement, technology acquisition, and TTP development.
* Evaluate the accuracy, reliability, and operational utility of predictive models through historical validation, performance metrics, and continuous analytical refinement.

**Technology Assessment and Capability Development**

* Partner with government and industry stakeholders to define research objectives, data collection methodologies, analytical requirements, and reporting standards.
* Transform analytical findings into actionable recommendations that guide C-UxS technology development, acquisition, selection, and operational employment.
* Develop and manage multi-phase technology implementation roadmaps across business units, translating functional requirements into actionable system configurations.
* Perform due diligence on emerging AI, machine learning, and other advanced technologies that can enhance C-UxS detection, tracking, classification, and analytical capabilities.
* Identify anticipated capability gaps by evaluating projected threat evolution against existing and planned C-UxS technologies, operational concepts, and system performance.
* Support technology investment and acquisition decisions by forecasting future operational requirements and assessing the effectiveness of potential C-UxS solutions against emerging threats.

**Research, Modeling, and Program Support**

* Apply operations research, systems analysis, statistical modeling, and quantitative methodologies to complex operational and technical challenges.
* Support business process improvement initiatives, including performance management, statistical process control, organizational assessment, and regulatory compliance.
* Conduct modeling and simulation, strategic planning, operational analysis, and decision support to advance program objectives.
* Develop analytical scenarios and simulations to assess potential UxS threat evolution, operational impacts, and the effectiveness of proposed countermeasures.
* Assist with program planning and oversight, exercise development and execution, and program evaluation.
* Support system-level analysis and integration activities, including assessments of emerging threats, system vulnerabilities, and operational effectiveness.
* Provide technical assessment and evaluation support that complements government technical experts in applying acquisition initiatives and research, development, test, and evaluation (RDT&E) activities to DHS mission requirements.

**Leadership, Collaboration, and Compliance**

* Communicate complex analytical findings, predictive assessments, and operational recommendations to senior government and industry leadership.
* Conduct all activities in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and restrictions governing information collection, intelligence analysis, and law enforcement activities within the United States.
* Supervise analytical and technical staff as assigned.
* Travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Must have an active Secret US Government clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance
* Ability to pass DHS Entry on Duty (EOD) requirements and maintain Public Trust suitability

University of Phoenix is a leading higher education institution founded in 1976 by Dr. John Sperling. Our mission is to improve the lives of our students, their families and future generations through higher education. Our values (which hopefully you share) are: Brave. Honest. Focused.

  

Our University values and embraces all team members and their unique perspectives. We fundamentally believe in fostering an environment which deeply respects, celebrates, and actively encourages a diverse workforce. We are committed to hiring – and learning from – those who share our passion to help others achieve their educational aspirations.

  

We offer excellent benefits, an effective recognition program, and outstanding learning and development tools, including tuition vouchers for employees and their qualified family members.

**About the Position**

The Senior Operations Data Analyst uses analytical methods and tools to perform business analysis and operations research. An individual collaborates with key stakeholders throughout the University to create predictive models, incorporate relevant internal and external data, and combine and model data from multiple sources into analyses that provide new insights and inform strategy, including the annual strategy review process, annual budget planning, and other key executive-level meetings. The Senior Operations Data Analyst synthesizes data, articulates implications and options, and produces high quality research and reports that provide the needed business intelligence to executive and senior leadership for data-driven, informed decision making and strategic direction.

**What You’ll Do:**

1. Collect, analyze, and interpret data related to higher education trends, student enrollment, retention, and graduation rates to produce high quality research and reports to inform data-driven decision making and provide insight into development of strategic direction; Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and provide data-driven insights to support strategic initiatives.

2. Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and security by implementing appropriate data governance practices and protocols.

3. Identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data to identify areas of improvement and make recommendations for operational efficiency. Effectively Lead continuous improvement in area(s) of responsibility through effective operational monitoring.

4. Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner, both verbally and through visually appealing data visualizations.

5. Develop and maintain operational reports and dashboards to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide insights to support decision-making.

6. Conduct ad-hoc data analysis to answer specific business questions and provide actionable recommendations.

7. Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in data analysis and business intelligence in the higher education industry.

8. Perform other duties as assigned or apparent.

  

NOTE: The Primary Accountabilities above are intended to describe the general content and requirements of the position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Incumbents may perform all or most of the Primary Accountabilities listed above. Specific goals or responsibilities will be documented in incumbents’ performance objectives as outlined by the incumbents’ immediate manager.

Supervisory Responsibility: None

* Bachelor’s Degree

* Five (5) years of experience in business analytics, business intelligence, and/or operations research

ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

* Master’s degree in a related field such as data analytics, business intelligence, statistics, or a similar discipline

* Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI

Description:

At CSpring, we believe in the power of data to drive decisions and real-world impact. We’re a purpose-driven consulting firm specializing in data strategy, data engineering, and data analytics. Our clients span the public and private sectors, and our work helps them solve complex problems, gain insights, and achieve measurable results.

We're seeking talented professionals who are collaborative, curious, and committed to making a difference that thrive at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy. Whether you're passionate about transforming public programs, enabling executive decision-making, or modernizing legacy systems, you'll find meaningful work and purpose here.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* **Purposeful Projects** – Improve systems that serve real people by delivering smarter data, streamlined processes, and strategic insight.
* **People-First Culture** – We’re as committed to your growth as we are to delivering high-impact solutions. You’ll find support, autonomy, and community here.

**What You’ll Do**

You’ll own the day-to-day documentation, coordination and analysis that keep Medicaid reporting deliverables moving, with limited supervision and guidance from the Medicaid SME:

* Gather, document, and manage business requirements for EDW reports, extracts, and enhancements, including federal reporting such as CMS-64/CMS-21 support, MARS, T-MSIS, and PERM.

* Write SQL to profile and analyze Medicaid enrollment, eligibility, provider, claims, encounter, and financial data to answer business questions and confirm requirements.
* Identify and document data anomalies and report variances, and work with ETL, BI, and QA teams to resolve them.
* Share use cases with data and quality analysts for profiling, review results, and confirm alignment with project requirements and Medicaid/CMS guidelines.
* Support testing and UAT, including test scenarios, acceptance criteria, defect reporting, and follow-up.
* Prepare presentations, summaries, and status updates for the SME, internal leadership, and the customer.

* Support end-user training and training materials related to reports and data.

* Peer review project artifacts and help manage intake and change requests, including impact analysis and BA effort estimates.

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, public health, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of business analysis experience, including requirements gathering, documentation, stakeholder facilitation, and user acceptance testing.
* 5+ years of experience working with healthcare data such as claims, encounters, eligibility/enrollment, provider, or financial data.
* 3+ years of experience with Medicaid or public-sector healthcare programs, such as State Medicaid/CHIP agencies, MMIS/MES vendors, Medicaid data warehouses, or Medicaid managed care plans.
* 3+ years of experience writing SQL to analyze and validate data in a relational database or data warehouse.
* Understanding of Fee for Service and managed care claim adjudication, from eligibility and enrollment through claims processing to funding/finance, including managed care encounters.
* Basic understanding of CMS reporting requirements for Medicaid.
* Experience writing use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria and supporting testing/UAT.
* Experience facilitating meetings and documenting outcomes.
* Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, MS Project, SharePoint, and Teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Organized and detail-oriented, and able to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines with limited supervision.
* Ability to travel to Springfield, IL up to three (3) times per year or as needed.

**Bonus Experience**

* Experience with CMS federal reporting such as CMS-64/CMS-21, MARS, T-MSIS, PERM, or similar projects.
* Knowledge of quality measures such as CMS Core Set, HEDIS, or CHIPRA.
* Knowledge of health insurance, HMO, and managed care principles, including Medicaid and Medicare regulation, the Affordable Care Act, and eligibility.
* Experience on a Medicaid Enterprise System (MES)/MMIS or Enterprise Data Warehouse DDI project.
* Experience with Teradata and SQL Assistant/Query Studio, Business Objects, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Familiarity with ETL and reporting processes.
* Experience with knowledge management tools such as Microsoft 365, SharePoint/Teams, and AI-enabled search.
* Experience with Azure DevOps or JIRA, and Agile/Scrum project

jobs.title: Security Analyst Investigator
jobs.description:
The Integrity, Investigations, Intelligence and Events (i3E) teams at Meta are dedicated to protecting the users of our family of applications (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Oculus) from a multitude of threats including: criminal organizations, human trafficking and exploitation, and scams/fraud. We are seeking a security analyst - threat investigator to investigate sophisticated threat actors, advance investigative methods, automate and mature team processes through tooling, and use innovative approaches to protecting people from offline harm. You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging, complicated, and high-visibility risks the company is facing.We are seeking an experienced security analyst to help drive our understanding and mitigation of child sexual abuse and exploitation on our family of apps. In addition to investigating complex threats, the candidate will have experience advancing investigative methods, and using innovative research approaches to prevent harm to children on our platforms.The candidate will have experience independently identifying and pursuing investigative leads, and delivering measurable outcomes aligned with team goals and will be able to extract, assimilate, and correlate a wide variety of data in order to surface, analyze, and disrupt threat actors across multiple spaces.  
  
  

### **Security Analyst Investigator Responsibilities:**

* Investigate complex child sexual exploitation operations to understand how abuse manifests on Meta’s platforms and the wider information ecosystem
* Lead a portfolio of investigative research to include identifying abuse trends, understanding adversarial behavior, and designing forward-looking enforcement strategies to mitigate harm
* Proactively hunt for threats and undetected abuse by leveraging internal data sets, open-source intelligence, and third-party private intelligence
* Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to advance investigations, quantify trends and support findings with clear, concise evidence
* Apply analytical rigor to investigations, analysis, and programs while looking for strategic improvement opportunities
* This role involves exposure to graphic and/or objectionable content including but not limited to graphic images, videos and writings, offensive or derogatory language, and other potential objectionable material, i.e. child exploitation, graphic violence, self-injury, animal abuse, and other content which may be considered offensive or disturbing

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years work experience performing security investigations in government, intelligence, cyber security, journalism and/or private sector organizations
* Subject matter expertise or prior work experience in child safety based laws or policies (i.e intelligence, law enforcement, legal analysis, or NGO)
* Experience with open source investigation techniques and familiarity with a variety of internet research tools
* Experience leveraging SQL, OSINT, and network security concepts in an investigative context
* Experience developing multi-source, evidence-based findings and communicating them to diverse audiences
* Proficient in SQL

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working or managing projects that have enterprise-wide impact and/or multi-organization cross functional stakeholders

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: Senior Information Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Planned Parenthood is the nation’s leading provider and advocate of high-quality, affordable sexual and reproductive health care for all people, as well as the nation’s largest provider of sex education. With more than 600 health centers across the country, Planned Parenthood organizations serve all patients with care and compassion, with respect, and without judgment, striving to create equitable access to health care. Through health centers, programs in schools and communities, and online resources, Planned Parenthood is a trusted source of reliable education and information that allows people to make informed health decisions. We do all this because we care passionately about helping people lead healthier lives. Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization that supports the independently incorporated Planned Parenthood affiliates operating health centers across the U.S. Planned Parenthood Action Fund is an independent, nonpartisan, not-for-profit membership organization formed as the advocacy and political arm of Planned Parenthood Federation of America. The Action Fund engages in educational, advocacy, and electoral activity, including grassroots organizing, legislative advocacy, and voter education.

**Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) and Planned Parenthood Action Fund (PPAF)**seek a dynamic and effective Senior Information Security Analyst**.** This job reports to the **Director, Incident Response Threat & Vulnerability Management** in the **Information Security Program** of PPFA. ThePPFA Information Security provides the strategy and implementation of the information security program that safeguards the data entrusted to Planned Parenthood by its patients, supporters, donors and staff.

### **Purpose:**

This role is responsible for supporting the Director of IR & Threat Vulnerability in building and maintaining the enterprise-wide Vulnerability, Incident Response and Cyber Threat Management programs. TheSenior Information Security Analyst performs all phases of the incident response life cycle: preparation, analysis, containment, eradication, remediation, recovery and post-incident activity for all incidents in support of the National Office and the Federation. Completes threat hunting in both on-premise and cloud environments. Responsible for identifying, triaging, filtering, and documenting vulnerabilities and threats across the enterprise and working with business unit partners to harmoniously resolve security matters. The Senior Information Security Analyst will help manage the MSSP partner for alert monitoring and will be tasked with responding, if necessary, to events/incidents on a 24x7 basis. The person will also be responsible for monitoring, building, augmenting, and integrating threat detection and remediation capabilities into security operations to address emergent cyber threats to PPFA products, services, data, and infrastructure. The Senior Information Security Analyst is expected to have a thorough understanding of complex systems and stay up-to-date with the latest security standards, products, and knowledge of the evolving threat landscape.

### **Delivery:**

* Respond to security incidents and investigations, acting as technical lead for all phases of Incident Response.
* Analyzes existing Incident Response (IR) processes and provides actionable technical recommendations to the immediate IR team..
* Maintains and updates procedures, guidelines, and playbooks to streamline security incidents under the guidance of IR leadership
* Maintain thorough documentation of cyber threats, threat vectors, threat actors, and threat trends for threat modeling activities and security incidents.
* Assist in developing policies, procedures, and playbooks for cybersecurity, intelligence, and data protection.
  + Mature and continuously benchmark the PPFA incident response playbook, liaising with vendor partners, Affiliate IT Leadership, and closely partnering with PPFA business functions.
* Monitors robust alerting and reporting mechanisms performed by MSSP as well as internal capabilities to potential cyber threats.
* Collects, analyzes, and maintains metrics and threat intelligence briefs that illustrate the impact of the current threat landscape.
* Coordinates with external forensics retainer to ensure confidential and in-depth investigations promptly, disseminating and maintaining reports on a highly confidential basis.
* Maintain current understanding of malicious adversaries, threat groups, and campaigns, indicators of compromise (IOCs), and highly granular tools.
* Develop work plans for IR and Threat Intelligence, as delegated by the Director, IR & Vulnerability Threat Management and complete initiatives within and across teams to ensure timely delivery.

### **Engagement:**

* Support the InfoSec Operations team with vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and logging and event management results that may indicate pre-incident indicators, ineffective processes, procedures, and standards.
  + Work with the team on recommendations and findings, both in written reports and in presentation format, to the Information Security Team and business unit partners
* Collaborate with key stakeholders at the National Office and the Affiliates on key findings and root cause analysis improvements.
* Support executive leader communications on potential emergent threats and ongoing efforts to resolve active cybersecurity incidents and investigations.

The above hiring range represents the University's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.*

  

Position Summary

Columbia Technology Ventures is the technology transfer office for Columbia University and a central location for many of the technology development initiatives, entrepreneurial activities, external industry collaborations, and commercially-oriented multidisciplinary technology innovations across the university. CTV’s core mission is to facilitate the transfer of inventions from academic research labs to the market for the benefit of society on a local, national, and global basis. Each year, CTV manages more than 400 invention disclosures, 100 license deals, and 20 - 30 new IP-backed startups, involving over 750 inventors across Columbia's campuses. CTV currently has over 1,500 patent assets available for licensing, across research fields such as bio, IT, clean tech, devices, big data, nanotechnology, materials science, and more.

CTV has extensive experience founding and supporting technology initiatives to enable promising technologies to accelerate across the “valley of death” and reach the market as quickly and successfully as possible. Many of these initiatives are explicitly multi-institutional, requiring extensive collaboration with our peer universities and their tech transfer offices. A few of the organizations CTV has been instrumental in establishing are the PowerBridgeNY clean energy proof-of-concept center, the NYC Media Lab, and the Columbia Biomedical Technology Accelerator (Columbia BiomedX), formally the Columbia-Coulter Translational Research Partnership. In addition, Translational Therapeutics (TRx) Resource was launched in 2016, in collaboration with the Irving Institute for Clinical and Translational Research and The Clinical Trials Office, to advance novel therapeutics from the lab towards the path of commercialization and clinical implementation.

CTV’s efforts are backed by 45 full time staff and an additional 30+ graduate student interns (CTV Fellows), providing broad support to the Columbia community and other stakeholders with marketing, legal (patents, contracts, etc.), business start-up help, and administrative tasks. CTV also runs an Executive-in-Residence program, which brings seasoned industry executives, serial entrepreneurs, and investors to campus to support faculty and student entrepreneurial activities.

Columbia Technology Ventures is seeking a **Business Development Operations & Market Research Analyst** to drive strategic intelligence, AI tool integration, and database management in support of Business Development initiatives and office-wide process improvements. Working closely with the Business Development Officer and Portfolio Manager, this role focuses on the proactive matchmaking of university innovations to external funding and licensing opportunities.

Responsibilities

**AI & Data Infrastructure Integration**

* Lead the design and deployment of AI-driven workflow, including customized LLMs and automated data extraction pipelines, for the Business Development (BD) and Lab-to-Market (L2M) team to optimize matchmaking between Columbia University’s technology portfolio and external industry partners. Improve existing Columbia Technology Ventures (CTV) AI capabilities within the existing Columbia IT and AI infrastructure and develop new and improved AI tools that further empower the BD team to accelerate team operations with greater targeting accuracy. This effort leverages both internal and external-facing data to primarily service BD/L2M activities that support office-wide licensing and commercialization efforts.

**Market Intelligence & Trend Analysis**

* Monitor and analyze capital flow, venture funding, and market trends across life sciences and physical sciences sectors to inform the CTV BD/L2M team’s commercialization strategies, and the licensing efforts of the CTV office. Leverage AI and build automated workflows to continuously gather, synthesize, and distribute actionable market intelligence to the BD/L2M team. Determine reliable and actionable public sources of funding data that influence academic tech transfer operations. Align with licensing priorities to identify, track, and attend targeted local networking events and conferences to formalize external investor/industry relationships.

**Relationship & Database Management**

* Build and maintain an active, high-fidelity contact database of active/up-to-date industry and VC connections, ensuring the BD/L2M team is equipped to introduce licensable technologies to the correct stakeholders in real-time. Organize existing external contacts and develop automated tools to facilitate both historical and new lead tracking.

**Venture Mapping & Peer Benchmarking**

* Actively identify and track venture capital firms, corporate partners, and startups investing in technologies aligned with Columbia's research outputs. Work with supervisors and the BD/L2M team to implement best practices emerging from peer institutions / tech transfer offices.

**Portfolio Strategy**

* With guidance from the supervisor, organize and analyze CTV's internal portfolio data, providing actionable insights that allow the Licensing team to be highly targeted in their outreach and licensing efforts. Generate actionable insights by building dynamic tools that merge internal licensing data with external metrics.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager - Advanced
jobs.description:
RiVidium Inc. is seeking an experienced Information Systems Security Manager – Advanced to support the NGA Defender program. The selected candidate will be responsible for managing and overseeing the cybersecurity posture of assigned programs, organizations, systems, or enclaves.

The ISSM-Advanced will provide cybersecurity leadership, manage information security risks, oversee security controls, and ensure that cybersecurity requirements are integrated into system operations, development, acquisition, and continuity planning. This position requires the ability to advise senior leadership on security risks, coordinate cybersecurity assessments, monitor security effectiveness, and implement strategies that protect mission-critical information systems.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and oversee the cybersecurity posture of assigned information systems, programs, organizations, or enclaves.
* Advise senior management and Authorizing Officials on cybersecurity risks, security posture, and changes that may affect organizational security.
* Develop and align information security priorities with organizational cybersecurity strategies and mission objectives.
* Manage cybersecurity resources, including budgets, staffing, contracts, and personnel, to support security goals and reduce organizational risk.
* Establish and maintain information security architecture, policies, procedures, operational guidance, and standard operating procedures.
* Evaluate cybersecurity policies, programs, systems, and processes to assess effectiveness, cost-benefit, and risk.
* Ensure security safeguards are appropriately implemented and that security improvement actions are evaluated, validated, and completed.
* Coordinate cybersecurity inspections, tests, reviews, and assessments across the network environment.
* Participate in information security risk assessments supporting the Security Assessment and Authorization process.
* Monitor cybersecurity data sources, maintain situational awareness, and collect information required for security reporting.
* Oversee cyber threat analysis and the development and dissemination of Computer Network Defense guidance and reports.
* Coordinate cybersecurity incident information with appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
* Integrate cybersecurity requirements into system development, technology acquisitions, system upgrades, and security engineering activities.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify their potential impact on information security and organizational risk.
* Oversee cybersecurity training and awareness programs to ensure personnel understand their security responsibilities.
* Support enterprise continuity of operations, mission assurance, and contingency planning, including cybersecurity and supply chain risk management.
* Identify security control deficiencies, noncompliance patterns, and vulnerabilities; assess associated risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Apply knowledge of host-based and network-based intrusion detection capabilities to support cybersecurity monitoring and defense.
* Identify critical infrastructure systems and technology components that lack appropriate security considerations and recommend corrective actions.
* Communicate cybersecurity requirements, risks, and priorities to senior leadership, technical personnel, and other stakeholders.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* **Required certification: CISSP-ISSMP or GSLC, with the applicable IAT, IAM, or IASAE Level III certification**
* Demonstrated experience in information systems security management, cybersecurity, or information assurance.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity risk management, security controls, security architecture, and system security requirements.
* Experience evaluating security risks and recommending appropriate mitigation measures.
* Experience coordinating cybersecurity assessments, inspections, testing, and remediation activities.
* Knowledge of security incident reporting, threat analysis, intrusion detection, and network defense practices.
* Experience developing or maintaining security policies, procedures, plans, and operational guidance.
* Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, technical teams, and security stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and documentation skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting federal government or Intelligence Community cybersecurity programs.
* Experience managing cybersecurity requirements for mission-critical systems or enterprise networks.
* Familiarity with Security Assessment and Authorization processes and security control implementation.
* Experience with cybersecurity architecture, security engineering, and supply chain risk management.
* Experience supporting continuity of operations planning and mission assurance initiatives.
* Experience overseeing cybersecurity training, awareness, and compliance programs.

  

**Clearance- TS/SCI required**

  

**The annual salary range for this position is $165,000–$175,000.**

The listed salary range represents a general guideline; however, RiVidium Inc. considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate’s experience, education, skills, and current market conditions. At RiVidium Inc. it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

jobs.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
* **Employment Type:** Full Time
* **Directorate:** Cyber Security Engineering
* **Location:** Northern Virginia-Herndon/McLean
* **Clearance:** Active TS/SCI with Full Scope Polygraph Required
* **Experience Level:** Mid-Level, 3–5+ Years

Altus Consulting is seeking skilled Cyber Threat Intelligence Analysts to support a mission-focused Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC) and Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT) within a highly secure customer environment. The selected candidates will transform security telemetry and threat information into actionable intelligence that strengthens operational awareness, threat detection, incident response, and cyber defense decision-making.

This position requires hands-on security operations experience, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between cybersecurity operations and threat intelligence. The Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst will analyze data from SIEM, SOAR, IDS/IPS, network monitoring, and endpoint security platforms, translating findings into actionable intelligence products, threat reporting, dashboards, playbooks, and operational procedures that improve cyber defense capabilities.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
---------------------

* Analyze security data from SIEM, SOAR, IDS/IPS, network monitoring, endpoint detection, and other cybersecurity platforms.
* Identify, track, and assess adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Correlate threat intelligence with security events to improve detection, triage, threat hunting, and incident response activities.
* Produce actionable intelligence reports, threat briefings, cyber situational awareness products, and adversary assessments for operational stakeholders.
* Develop threat profiles and intelligence products that support security operations and cyber defense decision-making.
* Integrate cyber threat intelligence into daily SOC and incident response workflows.
* Support incident investigations by providing contextual intelligence and adversary attribution where appropriate.
* Collaborate with security engineers, analysts, responders, and leadership to operationalize cyber threat intelligence.
* Identify intelligence gaps and recommend improvements to detection, monitoring, and response capabilities.
* Develop executive and operational dashboards using Splunk, Elastic, or related analytics platforms.
* Create visualizations that communicate emerging threats, attack trends, threat actor activity, and operational metrics.
* Develop and maintain cyber defense playbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and analytical methodologies.
* Document threat hunting processes, incident response procedures, and CTI workflows.
* Assist with automating intelligence collection, enrichment, analysis, and reporting activities.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance cyber defense operations and mission effectiveness.

**PREFERRED SKILLS:**
---------------------

* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Experience conducting cyber threat analysis and intelligence production.
* Knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and adversary TTP analysis.
* Experience developing dashboards, reports, and security visualizations.
* Experience supporting threat hunting, cyber defense, incident response, or security operations activities.
* Experience writing technical documentation, operational playbooks, and standard operating procedures.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts and secure development practices.
* Experience with EDR/XDR technologies and threat intelligence platforms such as MISP, ThreatConnect, Anomali, or Recorded Future.
* Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, or other automation and scripting technologies.
* Experience with cloud security monitoring in AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud environments.
* Experience developing security use cases, correlation rules, and detection engineering content.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting Intelligence Community, Department of Defense, or Federal cybersecurity environments.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**
-------------------------

* **Active TS/SCI clearance with Polygraph is required.**
* Three to five or more years of experience supporting a Security Operations Center (SOC), Cyber Defense Team, Cyber Incident Response Team, or similar cybersecurity mission environment.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM, SOAR, IDS/IPS, network monitoring, endpoint security, or related cybersecurity technologies.
* Experience working with Splunk Enterprise Security, Elastic/ELK Stack, or comparable cybersecurity analytics platforms.
* Experience conducting cyber threat analysis and producing actionable intelligence products.
