jobs.title: Physical Security Analyst
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton's Physical Security team is responsible for the safety and security of all Peraton facilities across the enterprise. The team delivers this mission through electronic access control systems, closed-circuit television (CCTV) and video management systems, intrusion detection, contracted guard services, visitor management, and ongoing physical security assessments. The team also plays a central role in Peraton's growth activities, forecasting physical security costs associated with new facility buildouts, program captures, and proposal efforts.

We are seeking a Physical Security Analyst to join the team as a junior-level individual contributor. This is a developmental role designed for someone with foundational experience in physical security, facilities, or a related security field who is looking to grow into a well-rounded physical security professional. The analyst will support the team's day-to-day operations as well as its proposal and growth activities, working alongside senior team members on real-world projects from day one.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Physical Security Operations Support**
----------------------------------------

* Support day-to-day administration of enterprise physical security systems, including access control, CCTV/video management, visitor management, and intrusion detection
* Assist with badge issuance, access provisioning/deprovisioning, and routine access reviews
* Monitor and triage physical security alarms and events; escalate as appropriate
* Support investigations into facility-related security incidents and compile supporting documentation
* Help maintain accurate inventories of physical security equipment, cameras, readers, and related assets

**Contracted Guard Force Support**
----------------------------------

* Help coordinate day-to-day interactions with contracted guard service providers
* Review guard post orders, patrol logs, and incident reports for completeness
* Assist with guard scheduling coordination and documentation of post requirements
* Support site visits and quality checks of guard operations

**Proposal and Growth Support (Pricing & Cost Forecasting)**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Support proposal and capture teams by developing physical security cost estimates for new facility buildouts and program expansions
* Research vendor pricing for access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and related physical security equipment
* Help maintain reusable pricing templates, standardized bills of materials, and historical cost data
* Compile physical security sections of proposal narratives under the direction of senior team members
* Participate in site surveys of candidate facilities and document findings

**Documentation & Reporting**
-----------------------------

* Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), site-specific security plans, and system documentation
* Prepare periodic reports on access control activity, incidents, and system health
* Support audits, physical security assessments, and compliance reviews
* Maintain organized project files and documentation for proposal and buildout efforts

**Collaboration**
-----------------

* Partner with Facilities, IT, Program Security, and HR teams on cross-functional efforts
* Interact professionally with employees, contractors, and visitors regarding physical security matters
* Participate in team meetings, project reviews, and ongoing training

##### **Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Homeland Security, Security Management, Business, or a related field —
* At least 1 year of experience in physical security, facility security, law enforcement, military security operations, or a closely related role
* 6+ years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Working familiarity with physical security concepts: access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, visitor management, and guard operations
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office — particularly Excel (for pricing/cost work), Word, and Outlook
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism
* US Citizenship required
* Ability to obtain a secret security clearance.
* Ability to work on-site at Peraton facilities as needed and travel occasionally to other Peraton locations

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Hands-on experience with any enterprise access control platform (e.g., Lenel, AMAG, Software House/C•CURE, Genetec, Avigilon)
* Familiarity with any video management system (e.g., Milestone, Genetec, Avigilon, Salient)
* Experience supporting proposals, pricing, or cost estimates in a government contracting environment
* Exposure to physical security standards — UL 2050, DoD / IC construction standards, ICD 705 fundamentals, or RMF controls (CP, PE families)
* Prior experience interacting with contracted guard services
* Active or prior security clearance (Secret or higher)
* Industry certifications such as PSP

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Last Mile Rental (LMR) team is redefining how we power last-mile delivery by ensuring the right vehicles are in the right hands at the right time — at scale. As an Sr. Program Manager on the LMR team, you will sit at the intersection of fleet operations, vendor management, and cross-functional strategy, owning programs that directly impact Amazon's ability to deliver for customers every day. If you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and love turning complex operational challenges into scalable solutions, this role is for you. We own end-to-end program management for LMR operations, from vendor performance to capacity planning and deployment. LMR drives execution across the LMR network through partnering with a diverse set of stakeholders to including: Amazon Global Fleet & Products teams managing Maintenance, Vehicle Allocation, and Technology work streams. As well as external strategic partner relationships such as Fleet Management Companies (FMC), Fleet Providers, and Service Vendors. We operate as a strategic orchestrators, balancing tactical urgency with long-term planning to keep Amazon's delivery fleet running at peak efficiency. Our work exists in high-visibility, high-impact environment where your decisions directly influence delivery capacity for millions of customers and every cost penny saved translates to millions captured in downstream impact.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Vendor Management: Oversee day-to-day relationships, performance of LMR vendors, external partners; holding vendors accountable to SLAs and drive continuous improvement.
* Capacity Planning & Deployment: Support strategic planning for LMR fleet capacity, vehicle deployment, and resource allocation across the network.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the connective tissue across a constellation of Amazon Global Fleet & Products teams such as: Fleet Planning, In life Services, Re-deployment, Procurement, Deployment; as well as external FMC teams — ensuring alignment, surfacing risks, and driving resolution.
* Program Execution: Lead implementation of projects impacting broader LMR operations, from requirements gathering through execution and post-launch review.
* Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze LMR performance metrics including utilization rates, vendor performance, and fleet health; generate Weekly Business Review (WBR) narratives with structured Highlights, Lowlights, and Actions.
* Stakeholder Communication: Draft and deliver concise, data-driven updates to Amazon senior leadership and cross-functional partners; maintain visibility on open items and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Process Improvement: Identify and close coordination gaps; build scalable processes and documentation (SOPs, Process Review documents, Business Review documents, Annual/3Y Plan documents, and budget planning) to improve operational efficiency.

* 5+ years of program or project management experience

**Overview**

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) team builds and operates Microsoft datacenters, which in turn powers Microsoft’s cloud business. The CO+I Engineering team (CO+IE) delivers services, applications, and automation supporting datacenter planning, construction, and operation. We own a large portfolio of services, including workflows that enable predicable, lowest cost datacenter construction, telemetry systems that drive high availability and optimized energy usage, and task and performance management applications that help our operation run as efficiently as possible. CO+I Engineering is a competitive advantage for Microsoft, and an important pillar in its cloud success.

The **Technical Program Manager** of Critical Infrastructure Delivery will deliver complex network infrastructure projects, working with multi-faceted teams (full time employees and vendor staff) and have technical depth and experience in delivering bare metal infrastructure at scale, in operational environments. The successful candidate will be a team player, possess solid communication and collaboration skills, and have the ability to effectively manage and solve problems in alignment to standards and schedule. The role partners closely with colleagues, engineering and other infrastructure and operational teams, along with key decision makers across geographic and organizational boundaries, while maintaining excellence in installation of network infrastructure for high security networks in datacenters and other spaces.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* You will partner with hardware Engineering to design technical solutions deployable in the field. You’ll also identify risks and propose data-driven mitigations.
* You’ll define success criteria and create relationships for implementing field deployments for complex cross-functional projects. You’ll coordinate and ensure alignment across organizations.
* You will deliver on roadmaps for multiple bare metal field delivery pillars, track project schedules, develop staging and implementation plans, and ensure reporting data is in place to support governance programs.
* You’ll lead teams to partner with other departments to collect performance metrics, drive customer support, and lead direct field engagements.
* Manage relationships and expectations with various business stakeholders across CO+I.
* Create and contribute to processes, procedures, and tools to drive continuous improvements in execution.
* Participate in regular and annual planning strategies, including budget, contract execution that encompasses current and future scope commitments.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

* 1+ year(s) of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects
* 1+ year(s) of experience with cyber security concepts and a background driving projects that improve security outcomes

jobs.description:
Cyber Data Analyst

**The Opportunity:**  
As a cyber data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a Cyber Data Analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to uncover the critical data that advances criminal and national security investigations.

As a client-facing Cyber Data Analyst on our Civilian Agencies team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs, and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on cyber investigations and operations.

Work with us to drive national security decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

**You Have:**

* 5+ years of experience performing analysis on data from a variety of sources to prepare analytical reports, data summaries, and responses to inquiries
* Experience drafting clear, concise reports on complex data analyses
* Experience briefing technical findings to various stakeholders
* Experience managing the compilation, cataloging, caching, distribution, and retrieval of large data sets
* Experience implementing automation in processing, presenting, or manipulating data
* Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
* Bachelor’s degree

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience with data aggregation and ETL tools such as Splunk or Cribl
* Experience with network traffic analysis tools such as Wireshark, Zeek, and Arkime
* Experience with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or shell scripting

**Clearance:**

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

U.S. Citizens

Overview:

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing *Results that Matter*. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Space and Intelligence Division provides professional services to the US Space Force, Combatant Commands, Intelligence Community, and NASA. Our work includes enterprise architectural assessments, systems engineering and integration, test, planning and execution, cost estimating and analysis, acquisition support, and cybersecurity. We are trusted partners developing approaches and concepts to meet emerging high priority needs, assessing cutting-edge technologies, and supporting capabilities for our National Defense. Come join the fastest growing Division at Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc.!

The Space Systems Group (SSG), part of SPA’s Space and Intelligence Division, provides timely and objective assessments and recommendations integrating technical, operational, programmatic, policy and business analysis. We focus on our key clients in the Space community including the US Space Force’s Space Systems Command (USSF/SSC), one of the three designated Field Commands under USSF. We work tirelessly to provide integrated solutions based on information and communications throughout the chain of command. We provide clear and consistent analysis and recommendations which are aligned to strategic and leadership goals while balancing the ability to execute on time and on budget within the technical communities. Come join an organization responsible for being a key enabler of Spacepower!

SPA has a near-term need for a **Operations Research Analyst - Junior/Journeyman.**

* Support development and execution of analytical models and simulations for mission performance, system interactions, and architecture behavior.
* Assist in building scenario baselines, defining analytical assumptions, and developing MOEs/MOPs for use in engineering assessments.
* Perform data analysis, statistical evaluations, and visualization of model outputs to identify trends and performance drivers.
* Participate in trade studies, alternatives analyses, and mission-level assessments under senior guidance.
* Document analytical methods, findings, and recommendations in clear, decision‑ready formats.
* Collaborate with systems engineers, data analysts, and technical leads to ensure analytical products align with program objectives.

Qualifications:

**Required Qualifications:**

* US Citizenship with TS/SCI clearance at time of application with ability to obtain and maintain SAP clearance
* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Systems Engineering, or related field
* Basic understanding of modeling, simulation, optimization, or quantitative analysis methods
* Ability to interpret complex data and communicate results clearly
* Familiarity with analytical or statistical tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB) is preferred
* Ability to report to designated work location in Chantilly, up to full time, based on the needs of the customer

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree in Math, Statistics, Engineering, Physical Science, Operations Research, Data Science, or related field
* Exposure to digital engineering environments, MBSE methods, or system architecture concepts
* Experience supporting analysis of complex systems, operational scenarios, or performance tradeoffs
* Willingness to learn advanced MS&A techniques, reliability analysis, and forecasting methods

------------------------------

**Come join our team!**

Prince George’s County Government provides a dynamic and inclusive workplace where employees can thrive, learn, and grow across its 30 diverse agencies, all dedicated to serving the County's residents with essential resources and services. Nestled just minutes away from Washington, DC, Prince George's County combines urban vibrancy with serene surroundings, offering an ideal setting to live, work, and enjoy life.

The Prince George's County Government's **Health Department** is seeking qualified applicants to fill a **Business Analyst** **(Budget Management Analyst 3A)** position, grade **A24**, within its **Office of Administration**.

  
**About the Position:**
  
This is senior level professional and administrative staff work in all phases of budgetary development and administration or

legal, fiscal, social, environmental, tax rate and/or service delivery implications. While this class of work occasionally requires

The Prince George's County Health Department's (PGCHD) vision is that all Prince Georgians are their healthiest at every age and every stage. Their mission is to lead, engage, and empower our community to work collaboratively towards disease prevention, health equity, and total well-being. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

**About the Role:**

As a Technical Program Manager you will work as part of the management team of Lyra to manage large cross-functional development projects of significant strategic importance. This role will involve a large amount of collaboration with teams in the US, South Africa and our other operations worldwide.

It is an opportunity to help improve our systems and business processes as we help over 10 million people worldwide manage and improve their mental health and wellbeing.

**This is a fixed term contract until December 2027.**

You will be required to work Monday - Friday, 37.5 hours per week.

**Location:**

This is a hybrid position to be based in the UK or Ireland, with a requirement to attend the London office once a week. Some international travel to the US may be required.

* Lead and manage end-to-end technical programs involving multiple key stakeholder groups across Lyra’s international teams, driving the execution of the programs to time and budget.

* Communicate program progress clearly and regularly to all relevant stakeholders.
* Continuously assess the progress of programs, intervene to mitigate any delays or blockers, and flexibly respond to unforeseen issues to deliver the best results for the business.
* Support the leadership of technical teams within Lyra International Tech, where relevant, to provide project management frameworks, post release assessments, and advice.
* Support the Director of International Technology on the strategic management of roadmap goals across the department, including the development of department wide KPIs for key projects.

### **Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in program management or technical project management exceptional organisational skills.
* Proven track record of managing complex technical programs, including cross-functional coordination, stakeholder management, and delivery on time and on budget
* Strong experience working with engineering teams and understanding technical concepts, architecture, and development processes.
* Experience managing global or distributed teams, with an understanding of cross-cultural dynamics and remote work challenges across multiple timezones

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong proven understanding of software development and Agile development methodologies.
* Experience using program management and development tools, including Asana, Jira, and Confluence
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to engage and advocate with technical, non-technical and leadership teams.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, MS Dynamics, Azure Data Factory, and Netsuite is a plus.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices is a plus
* Experience in an international company is a plus
* Experience in a healthcare company is a plus

**Who We Are**

KIPP SoCal Public Schools is a nonprofit organization that operates 20 tuition-free, open-enrollment charter public schools, within 17 Local Education Agencies (LEA), educating more than 10,000 students and supporting 8,300 alumni to and through college and beyond. Together with families and communities, we create joyful, academically excellent schools that prepare students with the skills and confidence to pursue the paths they choose—college, career and beyond—so they can lead fulfilling lives and create a more just world.

At KIPP SoCal we build trusting relationships that are strengthened by high expectations and collaboration alongside laughter and joy. We set ambitious goals and hold each other accountable for students achieving their greatest potential. We work together with each other and in partnership with families and communities in the active pursuit of a more equitable world. We do the right thing, even when it's not always comfortable standing up and speaking out against anti-blackness, racism, oppression, and injustice. We persevere through obstacles and treat failure as an opportunity to learn and grow.

The Data Analyst will read, clean, and analyze data from various systems, create data visualizations, and present the visualizations with a focus on raising data literacy within the region. Success in this role requires the application of technical expertise, problem solving, adaptability, strong organizational skills, and continuous self-directed learning.

Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, the Data Analyst is responsible for the following:

### **Role Responsibilities: Regional Analytics Support**

* Serve as a responsive and reliable analytical partner to stakeholders across the organization, completing ad hoc data analysis requests accurately and within established turnaround times.
* Design and develop analysis reports and dashboards that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences including school leaders, HR, finance, and operations teams.
* Contribute to the prioritization and planning of short and long-term analytics needs across stakeholders, helping ensure the team's analytical capacity is directed toward the highest-impact work.
* Document all data analysis processes and methodologies thoroughly, creating transparency between data producers and end users and building organizational knowledge that reduces dependency on any single team member.

### **Role Responsibilities: Dashboard Development & Data Visualization (Tableau)**

* Build, maintain, and continuously improve Tableau dashboards that surface meaningful insights from student information, assessment, HR, and survey data for a variety of stakeholder audiences.
* Translate complex analytical findings and technical concepts into clear, accessible visualizations and narratives that empower non-technical stakeholders to understand and act on data confidently.

* Build and update tables in BigQuery as needed, ensuring data is structured, accurate, and aligned with established data standards and governance protocols.

### **Role Responsibilities: Data Modeling (dbt)**

* Develop and maintain dbt models that generate clean, well-structured master tables serving as the foundation for dashboards and reports across the organization.
* Write and maintain dbt tests that enforce data quality standards, ensuring that models produce accurate, consistent, and trustworthy outputs.
* Monitor and resolve dbt test warnings proactively, addressing data quality issues before they surface in downstream dashboards or reports.

### **Role Responsibilities: Version Control & Collaboration (Git)**

* Manage personal Git branches with discipline and consistency, following established branching conventions and keeping work organized and well-documented.
* Submit clear, well-described pull requests for all updates to the main branch, providing sufficient context for reviewers to evaluate changes efficiently.
* Participate in pull request reviews, providing constructive and technically sound feedback that upholds the team's standards for code quality and data model integrity.

### **Role Responsibilities: Scripting & Automation (Python)**

* Apply foundational Python skills to support analytical workflows, including minor code modifications, debugging, and scripting tasks that increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with analytics engineers and data engineers to identify opportunities where Python can be leveraged to automate or streamline analytical processes.

**Job Summary**

The Program Manager oversees the daily staff, administrative workflows, operational resources, and regulatory compliance supporting ARS substance use disorder (SUD) treatment programs, clinical teams, and facility-based services. Working under the direction of the Chief Operations Officer, the Program Manager identifies operational needs, resolves program friction points, and coordinates facility operations to maintain program capacity, quality client care, and organizational standards.

Success in this role requires sound administrative judgment, discretion, effective cross-departmental communication, and the ability to equip direct reports and program staff to execute standard operating procedures. The Program Manager ensures program compliance with California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) licensing standards, organizational policies, contractual requirements, and Incidental Medical Services (IMS) regulations where applicable.

**Essential Functions**

* General Program Operations & Supervisory Oversight

* Staff Leadership & Supervision: Supervise assigned direct reports (including the Residential Services Manager and program administrative staff), establishing clear performance expectations, conducting coaching, evaluating job performance, and managing progressive discipline.
* Capacity & Occupancy Management: Monitor program capacity and coordinate admissions and census tracking to maintain appropriate facility occupancy while supporting quality client care.
* Client Care & Intake Coordination: Oversee client intakes, room/bed assignments, transfers, and step-down or discharge planning in consultation with the Clinical Team and program supervisors.
* Recordkeeping & Chart Quality: Oversee the completeness, accuracy, and timely maintenance of client charts, personnel records, electronic health record (EHR) entries, and required state reporting systems within assigned areas of responsibility.
* Facility & Resource Coordination: Monitor program facilities, supplies, nutrition, and physical plant conditions, coordinating maintenance and supply needs with responsible departments to maintain safe, clean, and compliant environments.
* Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Facilitate structured coordination between program operations, clinical services, medical/nursing staff, administrative departments, and executive leadership.
* Incidental Medical Services (IMS) & Clinical Operations Management

* IMS Program Governance: Oversee facility operational systems to ensure full alignment with DHCS licensing regulations and ARS Incidental Medical Services (IMS) policies across all applicable categories (medical history screening, health status monitoring, testing, treatment support, medication oversight, and withdrawal management support).
* Medical & Health Services Oversight: Ensure established operational protocols are in place for client health screenings, routine health status monitoring, vital signs tracking, and emergency medical escalation, coordinating closely with licensed Health Care Practitioners (HCPs) and Clinical Leadership.
* Medication Systems & Physical Plant Compliance: Oversee program medication storage protocols—including double-lock medication security, locked narcotic storage, MAR audit controls, and IMS room physical plant standards—ensuring staff adhere to nonmedical medication oversight policies.
* Care Coordination & MAT Support: Ensure program pathways support client access to Medications for Addiction Treatment (MAT), Narcotic Treatment Programs (NTPs), and external healthcare providers, eliminating administrative barriers to client care.
* Regulatory Compliance, Quality Assurance & Risk Management

* Licensing & Staffing File Compliance: Maintain required facility licensing files, ensuring current DHCS staffing disclosures, Health Care Practitioner acknowledgements , professional licenses, and staff training documentation are complete and up to date.
* Quality Control & Auditing: Conduct routine quality assurance reviews of client records, medication logs, and facility documentation; participate in periodic operational audits and physical plant inspections to identify and resolve compliance gaps.
* Incident Reporting & State Notifications: Ensure timely completion and escalation of internal incident reports, mandatory state notifications (DHCS filings), and regulatory communications regarding critical events, medical transfers, or policy updates.

Requirements:

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Human Services, Social Work, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of five (5) years of administrative or supervisory experience in alcohol and drug treatment programs, with demonstrated knowledge of program operations.
* Thorough knowledge of DHCS Title 9 residential licensing regulations, Incidental Medical Services (IMS) standards, MAT requirements, and applicable labor laws.
* Solid understanding of the recovery process, substance use disorder treatment dynamics, level of care considerations, and trauma-informed program management.
* Proven ability to manage, coach, and hold direct reports accountable while fostering a collaborative, supportive workplace culture.
* Proficiency in electronic health record (EHR) systems, Paylocity/HRIS tools, data reporting, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Valid California Driver’s License and clean driving record.
* Successful completion of required background screening (DOJ/FBI).
* Current tuberculosis (TB) clearance and physician health screening.
* Current CPR and First Aid cert

**Overview**
------------

The Staff Business Data Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for the analytical engine of defect reduction across the Expert Network. You own the measurement system that decides what gets fixed: you design defect detection and quantification approaches, build and analyze defect funnels, isolate root causes in large operational datasets, size the customer impact of candidate fixes, and validate — statistically, not anecdotally — that improvement initiatives actually moved resolution, quality, and customer friction outcomes.

This is an analytics role with a quality mission. You will apply descriptive, diagnostic, and causal analysis to one of the richest operational datasets anywhere — AI-scored conversation data covering ~100% of customer interactions — and translate it into a prioritized, defensible improvement roadmap. The Expert Network operates as a scaled contact center environment spanning multiple BPO vendor partner sites, and this role requires real fluency in how contact center operations run: queues, routing, transfers, handle patterns, and the operating rhythms that shape customer outcomes. Structured improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis) are tools in your kit for driving the fixes your analysis identifies; the analysis itself is the craft. You will operate as a single-threaded owner for specific defect domains and hold cross-functional partners — service delivery, training, partner management, product, and platform teams — accountable for their share of the quality outcome using evidence they cannot argue with.

**Responsibilities**

1. Analytics Strategy & Defect Measurement

* Design the measurement approach for assigned defect domains: define the defect, the opportunity base, and the DPMO *(Defects Per Million Opportunities)* instrumentation so every defect rate ladders directly to a customer outcome metric
* Build and maintain defect funnels — quantifying defect volume, severity, and contribution to outcome degradation — and evolve the defect taxonomy as the operating environment changes (new categories, refined severity weights, expanded coverage)
* Prioritize the defect backlog analytically: rank initiatives by modeled customer impact, and defend the ranking with data when it is contested

* Design the leading-indicator instrumentation beneath each outcome metric and monitor it for signal, drift, and regression
* Validate initiative impact with appropriate rigor: pre/post analysis with controls, cohort comparison, or causal methods where the stakes demand them — and say clearly when the needle did not move and why
* Partner with analytics and data science teams to evaluate, adopt, and improve AI-native quality measurement (conversation scoring, resolution scoring, customer distress detection) — including validating AI-scored metrics against human-labeled ground truth

In just five years under its current leadership, the company has grown from a $62 million community bank into a $500 million financial institution, the fastest-growing state-chartered bank, while building one of the fastest-growing mortgage platforms in the country.

Luminate Bank is building a technology team that moves fast and delivers. We are looking for a Senior Technology Project Manager who owns our bank technology projects from idea to go-live. * Manage implementations, upgrades and conversions with Jack Henry and other core, digital banking, payments and fintech providers.

* Identify and champion AI-enabled tools that speed up requirements, ticket writing and project management.

The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace! We are a vibrant, mission-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit. Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world. Whether contributing to world-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you!

 **Job Description**

**This position is a remote (U.S.-based), limited-term, grant-funded position expected to run through August 31, 2029, with frequent travel across East Africa.**

Are you a dynamic international development leader passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technology and climate innovation to transform agricultural livelihoods across Africa?

As the **Program Manager for East Africa**, you will serve as the operational anchor and strategic focal point for our flagship **AI Weather and Advisory Services portfolio**. Operating at the intersection of climate resilience, artificial intelligence, and scalable agricultural transformation, you will translate high-level global investments into high-impact, on-the-ground technical assistance across East Africa.

Reporting directly to the Secretariat Director, you will lead day-to-day coordination across country-based teams, collaborate with national ministries and meteorological agencies, and interface directly with Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs). You will drive work planning, milestone execution, budget management, and partner alignment to deliver actionable, AI-driven weather and agricultural advisories to millions of smallholder farmers.

**About AIM for Scale:**

The **Agricultural Innovation Mechanism for Scale (AIM for Scale)** is a global initiative dedicated to identifying, adapting, and scaling evidence-based, cost-effective agricultural innovations to improve smallholder farmer livelihoods and food security in low- and middle-income countries.

Co-hosted by the **University of Notre Dame’s Keough School of Global Affairs** and **New York University Abu Dhabi**, AIM for Scale is supported by world-renowned funding partners, including the **Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation** and the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**. The AIM for Scale Secretariat is proudly based at the Keough School of Global Affairs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Regional Program & Operations Management:** Oversee the day-to-day planning, execution, and monitoring of multi-partner technical assistance programs within the AI Weather & Advisory Services portfolio in East Africa.
* **In-Country & Regional Team Leadership:** Coordinate and support country-based implementation teams, ensuring cohesive work planning, clear deliverables, and shared accountability across regional partners.
* **High-Level Stakeholder & MDB Engagement:** Serve as the primary operational point of contact for national government agencies, agricultural and meteorological ministries, and Multilateral Development Banks (MDBs) to ensure program alignment and sustainable integration.
* **Work Planning, Budgets & Monitoring:** Lead the co-development of country work plans, track regional project milestones, monitor grant budgets, and manage risk assessments in close coordination with the Secretariat Director.
* **Technical & Donor Coordination:** Bridge the gap between research institutions, technology providers, host-country government officials, and philanthropic funders through high-impact communication and regular reporting.

  
**Qualifications**

**Education & Prerequisites:**

* **Advanced Degree:** Master’s degree in International Development, Agricultural Economics, Public Policy, Economics, Climate Science, or a closely related field with a minimum of **7 years** of relevant experience.
* **Alternative Credentials:** A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline plus an advanced professional certification with a minimum of **9 years** of relevant experience (or 5+ years with specialized advanced training) may be considered in lieu of a Master’s degree.
* **Required Experience & Technical Skills**
* **Portfolio & Program Leadership:** 7+ years of progressive experience managing complex, multi-partner international development programs—preferably with an emphasis on agriculture, climate services, digital development/ICT4D, or scalable technology.
* **Institutional Alignment:** Demonstrated track record of interfacing and collaborating with host-country government institutions, national agencies, and multilateral development banks (MDBs).
* **Partnership Engagement:** Proven ability to convene, align, and maintain momentum across diverse stakeholder groups, including government entities, research institutions, non-profit implementing organizations, and philanthropic funders.
* **Core Project Management:** Exceptional command of baseline program management disciplines, including budget monitoring, multi-country work planning, risk assessment, and milestone-based donor reporting.
* **Communication & Coordination:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; adept at coordinating across complex technical, government, donor, and research audiences.
* **Mobility:** Willingness and ability to undertake frequent international travel across East Africa as program needs dictate.

**Preferred Experience:**

* **Regional Expertise:** Direct professional experience in East Africa managing field operations, country office partnerships, or regional technical assistance portfolios.

**Compensation:** Starting at $80,000/salary

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Bonneville Labs is a flexible coworking and traditional lab space operator and developer optimized for a community of Bio-Doers, emerging biotechnology companies, community partners, and life sciences market leaders. Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. Bonneville Labs seeks to improve our world and lives by eliminating operational hurdles and reducing the cost of research and development for our member companies and allowing them to go forward, faster toward world changing discoveries and businesses.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**
============================================

Reports To: CEO

**Job Overview**
----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. This role builds structured systems, harmonizes workflows, and ensures programs move from planning to completion with clarity, accountability, and measurable outcomes. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.
* Balance strategic planning with hands‑on execution to keep programs moving without gaps or delays.
* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.
* Conduct post‑implementation reviews and initiate timely improvements when needed.
* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end planning and delivery of multiple related technology projects, managing scope, schedules, budgets, and resources.
* Develop program roadmaps, milestones, KPIs, and success criteria aligned with business objectives.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior stakeholders, providing transparent, data-driven status reports and executive-level updates.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery challenges.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, data/AI, QA, product, and other business functions.
* Manage collaboration across US-based onshore and offshore delivery teams.
* Establish and continuously improve program governance, delivery processes, and Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or hybrid methodologies.

* Monitor program performance through delivery metrics, dashboards, and regular reviews.
* Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and process optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 5 years managing technology programs or multiple concurrent projects.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex technology programs involving distributed, onshore/offshore teams.
* Strong stakeholder management, leadership, and communication skills, including experience presenting to executive audiences.
* Data-driven approach to program planning, performance reporting, forecasting, and decision-making.
* Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe, as well as traditional or hybrid delivery approaches.
* Hands-on experience with program budgeting, resource planning, risk management, and dependency tracking.
* Technical understanding of AI/ML solutions and Python-based applications sufficient to collaborate effectively with engineering and technical teams.
* Experience using program and project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

* PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, or equivalent program/project management certification.
* Experience delivering AI/ML, data engineering, or data platform initiatives.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience managing cloud migration or modernization programs.
* Familiarity with OpenStack and open-source infrastructure technologies.
* Experience in education, EdTech, or digital transformation programs.

Work Environment

* Remote work environment with collaboration across US-based onshore and offshore teams.
* Regular stakeholder meetings, steering committee updates, and program reviews.
* Cross-functional collaboration with technical, product, and business teams.

Why Join Academian?

Join Academian to lead impactful technology programs, collaborate with distributed teams, and contribute to innovative initiatives involving AI, data, and modern technology platforms.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Location:

* Remote (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

The Senior Strategic and Operational Intelligence Analyst delivers proactive, forward-looking analysis of the cyber threat landscape and translates that analysis into direction and action for Humana's information security organization. The analyst applies AI, automation, and disciplined analysis to identify what matters most, anticipate changes in the threat landscape, and lead action on priority cyber threats. The analyst is comfortable working directly with threat and security data, exploring patterns, testing hypotheses, and combining quantitative evidence with qualitative intelligence to produce defensible assessments and practical recommendations.

**Program Maturation and Tradecraft**

------------------

DoorDash's Global Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team helps the business scale securely through practical risk-based decisions, reliable controls and clear accountability. Our third-party risk program protects the systems and data behind our marketplace across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Security Risk Specialist, who will help run and shape our risk management program and treatment plans, enabling risk and control owners and security teams to keep risk at an acceptable level as the business grows. You will work cross-functionally to achieve business goals by running risk assessments and reporting, supporting exception requests when a policy can't be met, and helping automate the tooling and processes that keep our risk register accurate and trustworthy. You'll also help us build a more proactive risk function — going into specific areas of the business to deep-dive their controls, surface where things have gone wrong, and get ahead of issues before they surface.

You will report into the Senior Security Risk Manager on our GRC team in our Security organization.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Lead our global risk management process (assessing risk, negotiating treatment plans with owners, turning regulatory and framework changes into real, working controls)
* Get into the detail of how controls operate day-to-day, factoring in threat intelligence to make sure we stay ahead of new threat actors and attack vectors
* Manage policy exceptions by building compensatory controls or a case for risk acceptance instead
* Own risk reporting for key areas like security or engineering, becoming the go-to risk contact for at least one and helping reduce risk there in a measurable way
* Collaborate and report widely within our GRC and security teams and across the business
* Help shape our team's strategy and tooling as we grow by building your own automations rather than waiting on an engineer to build them for you

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 4+ years of experience in security risk, GRC, or a related field.
* You have a Bachelor's degree in a technology-related field, or an additional 4 years of work experience in a technology-related field.
* You're fluent in risk management frameworks, including the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).
* You know how to translate technical risk into language both technical and non-technical audiences can act on.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills, and can turn complex control requirements into clear, actionable guidance.
* You're comfortable owning risk metrics and reporting, and can show — not just assert — that a program is working.
* You have experience automating workflows, or an interest in agentic AI workflows.

**Nice to have:**

* You have experience implementing or using GRC tooling.

new_jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton's Physical Security team is responsible for the safety and security of all Peraton facilities across the enterprise. The team delivers this mission through electronic access control systems, closed-circuit television (CCTV) and video management systems, intrusion detection, contracted guard services, visitor management, and ongoing physical security assessments. The team also plays a central role in Peraton's growth activities, forecasting physical security costs associated with new facility buildouts, program captures, and proposal efforts.

We are seeking a Physical Security Analyst to join the team as a junior-level individual contributor. This is a developmental role designed for someone with foundational experience in physical security, facilities, or a related security field who is looking to grow into a well-rounded physical security professional. The analyst will support the team's day-to-day operations as well as its proposal and growth activities, working alongside senior team members on real-world projects from day one.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Physical Security Operations Support**
----------------------------------------

* Support day-to-day administration of enterprise physical security systems, including access control, CCTV/video management, visitor management, and intrusion detection
* Assist with badge issuance, access provisioning/deprovisioning, and routine access reviews
* Monitor and triage physical security alarms and events; escalate as appropriate
* Support investigations into facility-related security incidents and compile supporting documentation
* Help maintain accurate inventories of physical security equipment, cameras, readers, and related assets

**Contracted Guard Force Support**
----------------------------------

* Help coordinate day-to-day interactions with contracted guard service providers
* Review guard post orders, patrol logs, and incident reports for completeness
* Assist with guard scheduling coordination and documentation of post requirements
* Support site visits and quality checks of guard operations

**Proposal and Growth Support (Pricing & Cost Forecasting)**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Support proposal and capture teams by developing physical security cost estimates for new facility buildouts and program expansions
* Research vendor pricing for access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and related physical security equipment
* Help maintain reusable pricing templates, standardized bills of materials, and historical cost data
* Compile physical security sections of proposal narratives under the direction of senior team members
* Participate in site surveys of candidate facilities and document findings

**Documentation & Reporting**
-----------------------------

* Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), site-specific security plans, and system documentation
* Prepare periodic reports on access control activity, incidents, and system health
* Support audits, physical security assessments, and compliance reviews
* Maintain organized project files and documentation for proposal and buildout efforts

**Collaboration**
-----------------

* Partner with Facilities, IT, Program Security, and HR teams on cross-functional efforts
* Interact professionally with employees, contractors, and visitors regarding physical security matters
* Participate in team meetings, project reviews, and ongoing training

##### **Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Homeland Security, Security Management, Business, or a related field —
* At least 1 year of experience in physical security, facility security, law enforcement, military security operations, or a closely related role
* 6+ years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
* Working familiarity with physical security concepts: access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, visitor management, and guard operations
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office — particularly Excel (for pricing/cost work), Word, and Outlook
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism
* US Citizenship required
* Ability to obtain a secret security clearance.
* Ability to work on-site at Peraton facilities as needed and travel occasionally to other Peraton locations

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Hands-on experience with any enterprise access control platform (e.g., Lenel, AMAG, Software House/C•CURE, Genetec, Avigilon)
* Familiarity with any video management system (e.g., Milestone, Genetec, Avigilon, Salient)
* Experience supporting proposals, pricing, or cost estimates in a government contracting environment
* Exposure to physical security standards — UL 2050, DoD / IC construction standards, ICD 705 fundamentals, or RMF controls (CP, PE families)
* Prior experience interacting with contracted guard services
* Active or prior security clearance (Secret or higher)
* Industry certifications such as PSP

---------------

Amazon's Last Mile Rental (LMR) team is redefining how we power last-mile delivery by ensuring the right vehicles are in the right hands at the right time — at scale. As an Sr. Program Manager on the LMR team, you will sit at the intersection of fleet operations, vendor management, and cross-functional strategy, owning programs that directly impact Amazon's ability to deliver for customers every day. If you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and love turning complex operational challenges into scalable solutions, this role is for you. We own end-to-end program management for LMR operations, from vendor performance to capacity planning and deployment. LMR drives execution across the LMR network through partnering with a diverse set of stakeholders to including: Amazon Global Fleet & Products teams managing Maintenance, Vehicle Allocation, and Technology work streams. As well as external strategic partner relationships such as Fleet Management Companies (FMC), Fleet Providers, and Service Vendors. We operate as a strategic orchestrators, balancing tactical urgency with long-term planning to keep Amazon's delivery fleet running at peak efficiency. Our work exists in high-visibility, high-impact environment where your decisions directly influence delivery capacity for millions of customers and every cost penny saved translates to millions captured in downstream impact.

**Overview**

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) team builds and operates Microsoft datacenters, which in turn powers Microsoft’s cloud business. The CO+I Engineering team (CO+IE) delivers services, applications, and automation supporting datacenter planning, construction, and operation. We own a large portfolio of services, including workflows that enable predicable, lowest cost datacenter construction, telemetry systems that drive high availability and optimized energy usage, and task and performance management applications that help our operation run as efficiently as possible. CO+I Engineering is a competitive advantage for Microsoft, and an important pillar in its cloud success.

The **Technical Program Manager** of Critical Infrastructure Delivery will deliver complex network infrastructure projects, working with multi-faceted teams (full time employees and vendor staff) and have technical depth and experience in delivering bare metal infrastructure at scale, in operational environments. The successful candidate will be a team player, possess solid communication and collaboration skills, and have the ability to effectively manage and solve problems in alignment to standards and schedule. The role partners closely with colleagues, engineering and other infrastructure and operational teams, along with key decision makers across geographic and organizational boundaries, while maintaining excellence in installation of network infrastructure for high security networks in datacenters and other spaces.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* You will deliver on roadmaps for multiple bare metal field delivery pillars, track project schedules, develop staging and implementation plans, and ensure reporting data is in place to support governance programs.

* Participate in regular and annual planning strategies, including budget, contract execution that encompasses current and future scope commitments.

  
**Qualifications**

Cyber Data Analyst

**The Opportunity:**  
As a cyber data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a Cyber Data Analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to uncover the critical data that advances criminal and national security investigations.

As a client-facing Cyber Data Analyst on our Civilian Agencies team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs, and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on cyber investigations and operations.

Work with us to drive national security decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

**You Have:**

* 5+ years of experience performing analysis on data from a variety of sources to prepare analytical reports, data summaries, and responses to inquiries
* Experience drafting clear, concise reports on complex data analyses
* Experience briefing technical findings to various stakeholders
* Experience managing the compilation, cataloging, caching, distribution, and retrieval of large data sets
* Experience implementing automation in processing, presenting, or manipulating data
* Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
* Bachelor’s degree

* Experience with data aggregation and ETL tools such as Splunk or Cribl

Prince George’s County Government provides a dynamic and inclusive workplace where employees can thrive, learn, and grow across its 30 diverse agencies, all dedicated to serving the County's residents with essential resources and services. Success in this role requires the application of technical expertise, problem solving, adaptability, strong organizational skills, and continuous self-directed learning.

Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, the Data Analyst is responsible for the following:

### **Role Responsibilities: Regional Analytics Support**

* Serve as a responsive and reliable analytical partner to stakeholders across the organization, completing ad hoc data analysis requests accurately and within established turnaround times.
* Design and develop analysis reports and dashboards that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences including school leaders, HR, finance, and operations teams.

The Program Manager oversees the daily staff, administrative workflows, operational resources, and regulatory compliance supporting ARS substance use disorder (SUD) treatment programs, clinical teams, and facility-based services. **Overview**
------------

The Staff Business Data Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for the analytical engine of defect reduction across the Expert Network. You own the measurement system that decides what gets fixed: you design defect detection and quantification approaches, build and analyze defect funnels, isolate root causes in large operational datasets, size the customer impact of candidate fixes, and validate — statistically, not anecdotally — that improvement initiatives actually moved resolution, quality, and customer friction outcomes.

This is an analytics role with a quality mission. You will apply descriptive, diagnostic, and causal analysis to one of the richest operational datasets anywhere — AI-scored conversation data covering ~100% of customer interactions — and translate it into a prioritized, defensible improvement roadmap. The Expert Network operates as a scaled contact center environment spanning multiple BPO vendor partner sites, and this role requires real fluency in how contact center operations run: queues, routing, transfers, handle patterns, and the operating rhythms that shape customer outcomes. Structured improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis) are tools in your kit for driving the fixes your analysis identifies; the analysis itself is the craft. You will operate as a single-threaded owner for specific defect domains and hold cross-functional partners — service delivery, training, partner management, product, and platform teams — accountable for their share of the quality outcome using evidence they cannot argue with.

**Responsibilities**

1. Analytics Strategy & Defect Measurement
------------------------------------------

* Design the measurement approach for assigned defect domains: define the defect, the opportunity base, and the DPMO *(Defects Per Million Opportunities)* instrumentation so every defect rate ladders directly to a customer outcome metric

* Prioritize the defect backlog analytically: rank initiatives by modeled customer impact, and defend the ranking with data when it is contested

2. Analysis, Root Cause & Outcome Validation
--------------------------------------------

* Design the leading-indicator instrumentation beneath each outcome metric and monitor it for signal, drift, and regression
* Validate initiative impact with appropriate rigor: pre/post analysis with controls, cohort comparison, or causal methods where the stakes demand them — and say clearly when the needle did not move and why
* Partner with analytics and data science teams to evaluate, adopt, and improve AI-native quality measurement (conversation scoring, resolution scoring, customer distress detection) — including validating AI-scored metrics against human-labeled ground truth
* Design and operate human in the loop (HITL) quality processes: calibration sessions, human review sampling, and ground truth labeling workflows that keep AI scoring aligned to human judgment, with clear accuracy gates before any measure goes live

3. From Insight to Improvement — Driving the Fix
------------------------------------------------

Own the operating loop for assigned defect domains: defect detected root cause verified initiative launched outcome validated

* loop closed
* Deploy structured improvement methods — root cause analysis, Kaizen and rapid improvement events, value stream mapping, standard work — as the delivery mechanism for what the analysis has prioritized
* Translate analytical findings into technical solutions and roadmap commitments in partnership with systems and platform teams

4. Data Visualization, Insights & Executive Communication
---------------------------------------------------------

new_jobs.description:
About Altais:

At Altais, we’re on a mission to improve the healthcare experience for everyone—starting with the people who deliver it. We believe physicians should spend more time with patients and less time on administrative tasks. Through smarter technology, purpose-built tools, and a team-based model of care, we help doctors do what they do best: care for people.

Altais includes a network of physician-led organizations across California, including Brown & Toland Physicians, Altais Medical Group Riverside, and Family Care Specialists. Together, we’re building a stronger, more connected healthcare system.

  

**About the Role**

**Are you looking to join a fast-growing, dynamic team?**

We’re a collaborative, purpose-driven group that’s passionate about transforming healthcare from the inside out. At Altais, we support one another, adapt quickly, and work with integrity as we build a better experience for physicians and their patients.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic **Lead Healthcare Analytics Analyst** to drive data-informed decision-making across our Managed Services Organization (MSO). This role serves as a trusted analytics partner to operational and executive leaders, supporting key business functions including Provider Contracting, Network Development, Compliance, Claims Operations, Accounting, and Finance.

The Lead Healthcare Analytics Analyst will oversee complex analytical initiatives, lead analysts, and transform healthcare data into actionable insights that improve operational efficiency, financial performance, quality outcomes, and total cost of care. This individual combines deep healthcare analytics expertise with leadership, business acumen, and a passion for leveraging data to solve complex organizational challenges.

**You will focus on:**

**Analytics Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead and mentor a team of healthcare analytics professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and professional development.
* Partner with executive leadership and operational stakeholders to define analytics priorities and align solutions with organizational goals.
* Drive the development and execution of analytics strategies that support operational excellence and business growth.

**Reporting & Business Intelligence**

* Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and self-service analytics solutions that provide actionable insights across the organization.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for operational, financial, provider, and quality performance.
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear, concise recommendations for business leaders and stakeholders.

**Data Analysis & Insights**

* Analyze healthcare data across multiple domains including:
  + Claims
  + Eligibility
  + Provider Network
  + Utilization Management
  + Clinical Quality
  + Financial Performance
  + Population Health
* Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities that support strategic decision-making and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Conduct ad hoc analyses and special projects to address emerging business needs.

**Operational Partnership**

* Collaborate with leaders across Contracting, Provider Network Management, Compliance, Claims Operations, Accounting, and Finance to support operational and strategic initiatives.
* Provide analytical support for provider performance management, network expansion strategies, value-based care programs, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Develop data-driven recommendations that improve efficiency, provider engagement, member outcomes, and total cost of care.

**Data Governance & Process Improvement**

* Promote data integrity, governance standards, and reporting consistency across analytics platforms and solutions.
* Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and streamline workflows through innovative analytical approaches.
* Support enterprise data initiatives and contribute to the development of scalable analytics infrastructure and best practices.

**The Skills, Experience & Education You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Information Systems, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in healthcare analytics, business intelligence, data management, or related analytical roles.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience leading projects, mentoring analysts, or managing analytics teams.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis methodologies.
* Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Power Query, Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working with healthcare data warehouses, Epic/Caboodle, claims systems, and healthcare datasets.
* Strong understanding of managed care operations, healthcare finance, provider network analytics, claims processing, and utilization management.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and project leadership skills.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience supporting analytics for Managed Services Organizations (MSOs), Independent Physician Associations (IPAs), Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs), or health plans.
* Experience developing enterprise analytics strategies and leading cross-functional initiatives.
* Knowledge of value-based care, risk adjustment, population health management, and quality measurement programs.
* Experience with healthcare interoperability standards, clinical data models, and data governance frameworks.

**What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you will:

* Deliver trusted analytics that influence executive decision-making.
* Enable operational teams to improve performance through actionable insights.
* Drive automation and self-service reporting capabilities.
* Enhance data quality, governance, and reporting consistency.
